program.name: NexusCodex Intelligent Codex Upgrade
principles: Gameplay-first latency targets; DM actions must feel instant
Citations everywhere: every answer references doc/page/chunk
Progressive enhancement: ship value early; avoid big-bang rewrites
Resumable pipelines: long jobs must checkpoint and resume
Model-optional: provider interface supports local or API embeddings/LLMs
global_agent_rules: Preserve existing API contracts unless task explicitly changes them
Add tests for new parsing, retrieval, or schema logic
Use feature flags for expensive/risky behavior
Log timings and counts (pages, chunks, entities, links)
Never fail silently: store failure reason and continue where possible
Output PR-style summary: what changed, why, how to verify, rollback plan

notes: Use stricter approvals for commands that touch secrets, deployment, or destructive DB ops.

phases.name: Program Setup & Baselines
phases.goal: Establish measurement, documentation, and safe agent operating mode

tasks.title: Add ingestion benchmark harness
deliverables: scripts/benchmark-ingest.(ts|js) that runs representative ingestion flow and logs per-stage timings
README instructions for running benchmark
acceptance_criteria: One command runs benchmark and prints timings for render/ocr/extract/index/assets (as applicable)
Output includes doc id/hash and per-stage duration
tasks.agent_prompt:
Task: Add a benchmark harness for document ingestion.

Steps:
1) Create a script at /scripts/benchmark-ingest.ts (or .js) that ingests a sample document and logs timing for each stage (render, ocr, extract, index, assets).
2) If the repo already has an ingest pipeline, reuse it; do not rewrite business logic.
3) Add a README section describing how to run the benchmark and interpret results.

Constraints:
- Minimal dependencies.
- No production behavior changes.

Output:
- PR-style summary of changes
- Exact command(s) to run
- Example output

tasks.title: Create docs/upgrade-plan.md + ADR folder
deliverables: docs/upgrade-plan.md containing roadmap and baseline metric placeholders
docs/adr/0001-*.md template
acceptance_criteria: Plan explains how metrics will be tracked and where to find them
ADR template exists and is referenced
tasks.agent_prompt:
Task: Create program documentation scaffolding.

1) Add /docs/upgrade-plan.md summarizing the upgrade phases and referencing the benchmark script.
2) Add /docs/adr/ with a lightweight ADR template (context, decision, consequences).

Constraints:
- No code changes beyond docs.

Output:
- PR-style summary and links to new docs

phases.name: Performance & Pipeline Hardening
phases.goal: Make ingestion reliable enough for mid-session usage via staged jobs, checkpointing, and reduced queue blocking

tasks.title: Refactor ingestion into staged jobs with checkpoint/resume
deliverables: BullMQ (or equivalent) staged flow: ingest -> render -> ocr -> extract -> index -> assets
Checkpoint metadata per document hash to resume on failure
Progress logging per stage
acceptance_criteria: If a stage fails, rerun resumes from last completed stage (no repeating earlier stages)
Heavy asset generation (thumbnails/page images) does not block extraction/indexing
tasks.agent_prompt:
Task: Implement staged ingestion + checkpointing.

Steps:
1) Identify current ingestion worker/entrypoint(s).
2) Refactor into staged flow: ingest -> render -> ocr -> extract -> index -> assets.
3) Add checkpointing keyed by documentId + contentHash.
4) Ensure reruns resume at the last successful stage.
5) Separate asset generation into a lower-priority queue or stage.

Constraints:
- Preserve external API contracts.
- Add tests: checkpoint resume and stage ordering.

Output:
- PR-style summary
- How to reproduce a failure and validate resume

tasks.title: Parallel OCR worker pool + fast-path detection
deliverables: Fast-path: detect text-based PDFs and skip OCR
Parallel OCR worker pool for scanned PDFs
Config flags for pool size and thresholds
acceptance_criteria: Text PDFs ingest with OCR disabled
Scanned PDFs OCR time improves materially vs baseline (target 3–5x)
Pool size configurable via env/config
tasks.agent_prompt:
Task: Add OCR fast-path + parallel OCR pool.

Steps:
1) Add detection to classify documents as text-based vs scanned/image-based.
2) For text-based PDFs: skip OCR.
3) For scanned PDFs: parallelize OCR using a worker pool with configurable size.
4) Add logging: pages processed, per-page OCR time summary.

Constraints:
- Feature-flag expensive behavior.
- Add tests: classification and pool concurrency behavior.

Output:
- PR-style summary + benchmark delta notes

tasks.title: Batch DB writes to avoid write amplification
deliverables: Replace per-entity inserts with batch operations (e.g., createMany)
Add/verify indexes for common lookups during ingestion
acceptance_criteria: Structured entity extraction does not perform N round-trips for N entities
Logs show batch operations in use
tasks.agent_prompt:
Task: Reduce DB write amplification in ingestion.

Steps:
1) Find places where structured entities are inserted one-by-one.
2) Convert to batch inserts where safe (createMany / bulk insert patterns).
3) Add/verify indexes supporting ingestion and lookup patterns.
4) Add a regression test or benchmark assertion (e.g., ensure inserts are batched).

Output:
- PR-style summary + instructions to verify via logs

phases.name: Layout-aware Extraction & Parser Modularization
phases.goal: Stop fragile regex from being the critical path; improve multi-column and stat-block parsing

tasks.title: Layout-aware PDF text reconstruction
deliverables: Layout service that reconstructs reading order using PDF text positions
Column detection and stable per-page block ordering
Stored layout metadata and extraction confidence
acceptance_criteria: Representative multi-column pages no longer scramble text
Metadata includes per-page parse confidence and failure reasons
tasks.agent_prompt:
Task: Implement layout-aware extraction.

Steps:
1) Use existing PDF tooling (PDF.js or repo standard) to read positioned text items.
2) Reconstruct reading order; detect columns and order blocks logically.
3) Emit per-page layout metadata and parseConfidence.
4) Add 2–3 fixtures and tests to validate column order.

Constraints:
- Keep API contracts stable; store new metadata fields as additive.

Output:
- PR-style summary + how to run tests

tasks.title: Modular parsers + confidence scoring + fallback storage
deliverables: Parsers: MonsterParser, SpellParser (at minimum) with clear interfaces
Confidence scoring on extracted entities
Fallback path storing low-confidence entities as needs_review (still searchable)
acceptance_criteria: Parsers are unit-tested and independently runnable
Low-confidence outputs are not dropped; marked needs_review with reason
tasks.agent_prompt:
Task: Modularize extraction into parsers with confidence + fallback.

Steps:
1) Refactor extraction into dedicated parsers (MonsterParser, SpellParser).
2) Each parser returns {entity, confidence, raw_snippet, failure_reason?}.
3) If confidence below threshold, store as needs_review but include in search index.
4) Add unit tests for both parsers.

Output:
- PR-style summary + parser usage docs

phases.name: Chunk Store + Hybrid Semantic Search (BM25 + Vectors)
phases.goal: Enable robust retrieval with stable citations before full RAG

tasks.title: Introduce chunk storage model and chunking pipeline
deliverables: document_chunks store: docId, chunkId, pageStart, pageEnd, content, hash, source
Chunking strategy with overlap and heading-aware boundaries when possible
Dedupe on reingest using content hash
acceptance_criteria: Every chunk has stable citation fields
Re-ingesting same doc hash does not duplicate chunks
tasks.agent_prompt:
Task: Add chunk store and chunking pipeline.

Steps:
1) Create a document_chunks table (or equivalent store) with citation-ready metadata.
2) Implement chunker with overlap; prefer heading boundaries where available.
3) Add dedupe via contentHash/chunkHash.
4) Add tests for chunk boundary behavior.

Output:
- PR-style summary + migration notes

tasks.title: Embeddings provider interface and embedding generation
deliverables: Embeddings provider abstraction (local or API-backed)
Embedding generation for chunks with rate limiting / batching
Config flags for provider and dimensions
acceptance_criteria: Embeddings can be generated and stored for chunks
Provider can be swapped via config without code changes
tasks.agent_prompt:
Task: Implement embeddings provider interface.

Steps:
1) Create an EmbeddingsProvider interface.
2) Implement at least one provider (choose repo standard; stub allowed if no provider configured).
3) Generate/store embeddings for chunks; add batching and backoff.
4) Add docs for configuring provider.

Output:
- PR-style summary + config instructions

tasks.title: Hybrid semantic search endpoint returning ranked chunks + citations
deliverables: GET /api/search/semantic?q=...&topK=...
Hybrid scoring method (RRF or weighted BM25+vector)
Filters for campaign/document type/system/source
acceptance_criteria: Natural language queries return relevant chunks
All results include citations with doc/page/chunkId
tasks.agent_prompt:
Task: Build /api/search/semantic.

Steps:
1) Implement endpoint returning ranked chunks + citations.
2) Use hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vector similarity) with a tunable mixing strategy.
3) Add filters (campaign, docType, system, sourceBook).
4) Add integration test ensuring citations are always present.

Output:
- PR-style summary + example queries

phases.name: RAG Q&A with Strict Grounding + Citations
phases.goal: Provide Ask-the-Codex answers grounded only in retrieved chunks

tasks.title: Implement /api/search/ask with strict grounding and structured citations
deliverables: POST /api/search/ask endpoint
Strict grounding prompt (answer only from provided chunks)
Response schema: answer, citations[], snippets[], confidence, followups[]
acceptance_criteria: If evidence is insufficient, endpoint returns 'insufficient sources' without fabricated rules
Citations correspond to retrieved chunks
Optional reranker is feature-flagged
tasks.agent_prompt:
Task: Implement strict grounded RAG endpoint.

Steps:
1) Add POST /api/search/ask: {question, topK?, filters?}.
2) Retrieve chunks via hybrid search; optionally rerank (flag).
3) Generate answer with strict grounding instructions.
4) Return structured citations: {documentId, title?, pageStart, pageEnd, chunkId, confidence}.
5) Add evaluation harness with a small set of golden questions to assert citations exist.

Output:
- PR-style summary + how to run eval harness

phases.name: Canonical Entity Registry + Cross-Document Linking + Graph
phases.goal: Make entities connected and queryable across documents

tasks.title: Create canonical entity registry models and resolver
deliverables: DB models: entities, entity_aliases, entity_links with indexes
Deterministic resolver: normalization + alias matching + confidence
Link structuredData records to canonical entity IDs
acceptance_criteria: Same entity across docs resolves to canonical entity ID (or explicit versioning rule)
Ambiguity is captured with confidence and not silently merged
tasks.agent_prompt:
Task: Implement canonical entity registry.

Steps:
1) Add entities/entity_aliases/entity_links models with indexes.
2) Implement resolver with name normalization + alias matching; return confidence.
3) During ingestion, upsert canonical entities and attach entityId to structured data.
4) Add tests for deterministic resolution, duplicates, and ambiguous cases.

Output:
- PR-style summary + migration notes + resolver docs

tasks.title: Reference extraction + resolution worker to create typed links
deliverables: Unresolved reference store (mentions) with provenance (doc/page/snippet)
Resolution worker that links mentions -> canonical entities and writes typed edges
Confidence scoring and failure reasons
acceptance_criteria: Monster spellcasting text creates monster->spell edges
Edges include provenance (doc/page) and confidence
tasks.agent_prompt:
Task: Implement cross-document reference extraction and linking.

Steps:
1) Extract entity mentions from relevant text fields (stat blocks, descriptions).
2) Store unresolved references with provenance and context snippet.
3) Build resolution worker: resolve to canonical entity IDs and create typed edges (monster->spell, rule->condition, etc.).
4) Add tests for edge creation and provenance.

Output:
- PR-style summary + how to inspect entity graph for a sample entity

phases.name: Global Command Palette UX
phases.goal: Make search, entities, and Ask-Codex fast and discoverable during play

tasks.title: Implement command palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K) integrating keyword search, semantic search, and ask
deliverables: Command palette UI with grouped results (Docs/Rules/Entities/Ask)
Quick actions: open, copy link, bookmark (push-to-VTT stub OK until P7)
Basic e2e or component tests
acceptance_criteria: Palette opens with keyboard shortcut
Queries show semantic results with citations
Ask mode returns answer + citations
tasks.agent_prompt:
Task: Add Global Command Palette.

Steps:
1) Implement Cmd/Ctrl+K palette component.
2) Integrate existing keyword search plus /api/search/semantic and /api/search/ask.
3) Group results by type with badges and actions.

Output:

phases.name: VTT Integration + Real-time Entity Push
phases.goal: One-click push monsters/spells/items to VTTs with permissions and provenance

Websocket events: vtt:register, vtt:entity:push, vtt:state:update
REST fallback: /api/vtt/export/:entityId?format=foundry
At least one adapter (Foundry recommended)
acceptance_criteria: Only DM/presenter can push entities
Payload validates and includes provenance/citations
A reference receiver/test harness confirms payload shape

Steps:
1) Define VTTEntity schema and validators.
2) Add websocket events for VTT registration and entity push.
3) Add REST export endpoint for offline/manual imports.
4) Implement at least one adapter (Foundry) and a minimal test harness to validate payload.

phases.name: Quality Gates, Evaluation, and Scaling
phases.goal: Prevent regressions and make the system operationally maintainable

tasks.title: Automated eval suite for retrieval, RAG grounding, and ingestion regression
deliverables: CI job running eval suite
Golden query set for retrieval and ask endpoints
Regression thresholds for ingestion stage timings
acceptance_criteria: CI fails when citations missing in ask results
CI flags significant ingestion slowdowns vs baseline
tasks.agent_prompt:
Task: Build evaluation and regression gates.

Steps:
1) Add an eval runner that:
   - runs a list of retrieval queries and checks top results include citations
   - runs a list of ask queries and asserts structured citations present
2) Add ingestion regression checks using benchmark harness.
3) Wire into CI.

Output:
- PR-style summary + how to run eval locally
